notes.title: Update 0.7.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/6b66d0ecb641231cfaea5d4d05f317b52fb5c527.png


Important Changes


Mecha mode now consumes fuel. You refuel your Mecha by obtaining crystals. Fuel is now a separated resource and will cause no more crystal loss.
Added Mecha Fuel upgrade option.
Fixed a bug that caused Mjolnir’s damage lower than intended.
New settings option: Maximum Swarm Size. You may set the number to increase or decrease the maximum swarm size. Bigger swarm would be more satisfying for you to hack and slash, but also require higher spec.




Global Difficulty Changes


Increased crystal ore reserves for early game.
Increased resources obtained from killing elite insects.
Decreased resources obtained from killing Guardians.
Increased resource obtained from killing Insect Lord.
The growth rate of global Crystal Concentration will gradually decrease according to game progress.
Increased health growth rate of the insects from 0.7 to 1.0.
Increased damage growth rate of the insects from 0.1 to 0.15.
The HP of swarms when Doomsday Protocol is active has been increased grow faster.
The HP of elites, Guardians, and Gargantuan Eggs when Doomsday Protocol is active has been doubled.




Other Changes


Fixed a bug where the Chainsaw sometimes failed to trigger special effects.
Fixed a bug where reloading weapons too quickly would exceed the ammunition limit.
Fixed a bug where there was no sound effect when teleporting back to the base while using the Mecha.
Pressing the B button on the controller now closes the in-game menu and settings interface.

notes.title: Update 0.7.4
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/c781543451fcb9a046fac25e161a86ed52d03788.png


New Weapon for Mecha: Beam Saber


A light saber equipped on your arm at your service. Can strike from afar and burn its target.



New Weapon for Mecha: Laser Cannon


Shoot a beam of thick laser that will penetrate anything on its way.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/5ef7cd566888c4f59aaf5cab50921769b389e123.png


Other Changes


Fixed the Reloading Speed algorithm when the Reloading Speed upgrade is too high; removed the previous Reloading Speed limit; expect significantly faster late-game Reloading Speed
Slightly increased damage and initial firing rate for Heavy Machine Gun
When hitting the insect eggs on abandoned mine carts, more blood will burst out for better hit feedback
Fixed a bug where Orbital Bullet Storm and Flamethrowers couldn't damage the Swarm Lord VI
Fixed a bug where Mecha transformation was not possible when lacking Crystals
Fixed a bug where holding the fire button while equipped with a Nuclear Missile Launcher would interrupt the reloading process

notes.title: Update 0.7.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/cf52e12d5a8afdf825686e5716e69b78ff030631.png


New Weapon for Mecha: Mjolnir 


Swing the hammer of Thor to summon lightning strikes




New Weapon for Mecha: Orbital Bullet Storm 


Launch a salvo of bullets to the marked location by sending a beacon signal to the orbital weaponry; you may use your melee weapon while channeling the salvo




Other Changes


Implemented multi-monitor display settings; players may switch between monitors if there are multiple
The special effect when insects are hit by the Energy Whip is now more visible
Increased tracking range for auto-tracking weapons
Increased attack range for Chainsaw and Energy Whip
Fixed a bug where the floating explosion insects would go underground
Fixed a bug where the Gatling Gun would keep spinning even when not firing
Fixed a bug where the melee weapons of the Mecha would sometimes attack on their own after transformation
Fixed a bug where the missiles might sometimes explode indefinitely when launched by a ship moving in high-speed

notes.title: Update 0.7.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/2cd1df7482ca9a20fa34d8e3f61dbc0f9e341a35.png


 New Mecha Weapon: Antimatter Energy Whip


 Low direct damage dealt on hit, extremely high damage over time; smaller insects will become weightless when hit



New Mecha Weapon: Nuclear Missle Launcher


Consumes all ammo at once to launch a mini nuclear missle, dealing extremely high damage to all enemies within a very large area; can be launched only at full ammo; the more ammo it consumes, the higher the damage



Other Changes 


HP of smaller insects doubled during Doomsday Protocol
Fixed a bug where the Wormhole texture would flicker when stacked with obelisk ground

 New Weapons for Mecha


 Chainsaw: Deals damage over time. Drags lighter targets towards the chainsaw.
 Flamethrower: Deals damage over time in a large area and ignites its targets.

Mecha Mechanics Overhaul


Stats of the Mecha are no longer adjustable. The Mecha now has fixed, doubled base HP and 50% Damage Resistance, with other stats set to the previous highest level by default
The Mecha no longer needs Crystals to work
Movement speed of the Mecha now benefits from 20% of your Movement Speed Bonus
Greatly increased the animation speed of jumping landing strike of the Mecha


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/58bc2d3d3b75a13d70e14df6dc7e2e1a853ff44d.png

Slightly increased HP growth rate of insects
Fixed a bug where the player might be defeated by nearby Swarm Lord(s) even after entering the hanger
Fixed a bug introduced along a previous update which caused HP decreasing effect to be disabled
Adjusted key/button display effect
Enhanced the effect of Gatling gun hitting the ground for Mecha

Now Available: Doomsday Protocol


Doomsday Protocol consists of a new series of missions
More missions will be available in the coming updates, together with new Swarm Lords


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/5bbec1cafb2a76361b21f58d0aa84693be16e435.png

Emerges from underground
Can spit out numerous insects
Will constantly attract Swarms
Immobile


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/9feaa5457c18f4d7ca8a6de3258b7f890297b2c0.png

Other Changes


Changed basic Crystal Concentration and Risk Level modifier after killing each Swarm Lords for the first time as follows:

Swarm Lord I：5
Swarm Lord II：10
Swarm Lord III：20
Swarm Lord IV：40
Swarm Lord V：80

Heightened default viewpoint

notes.title: Update 0.5.9
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/334a1f228f9986994e6c7919bfcd5220316cbaa2.png


New Special Region: The Gargantuan Eggs


When exploring in the desert, you will have a chance to find a region covered by piles of flesh and blood, with a gigantic egg silently sitting there
You may find this region only after defeating the third Swarm Lord
The Gargantuan Egg will be marked as a question mark (?) on your Radar HUD before it’s actually found
A previously defeated Swarm Lord will be hatched from the Egg when it's broken
The hatched Swarm Lord, although being a wild one, will grant the same reward as Mission Swarm Lords; the reward will also scale to the Risk Level
Upon entering the region, you will face suicidal, non-stop attack of insects from one direction; it will stop when the Egg is broken or until you have left the region


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/60a5a41bba7e5a57c2e864b5a38f68b124fee600.png


Gargantuan Egg


Each contains a Swarm Lord


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/b25cedea467279a24b0d6e1c7e1dd2fd1be26589.png


New Blood Insect


Floating
Self-destructing explosion attack
Its explosion deals high damage to a large area
They will come pouring out of underground when something needs to be defended


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42406258/2c4c1218299b1739cada1a0043b855e207a9fd25.png


Other Changes


Marks of Mission Swarm Lords are now yellow, while Wild Swarm Lords having red marks
The Swarm will now not flee from the player when a Wild Swarm Lord is defeated
Increased spawn rate of Magma Zones; all special regions now have the same spawn rate
Obelisk transmutation speed increased by 25%
Armor repaired upon obtaining Crystal Shards reduced from 0.002 to 0.001
Energy replenished upon obtaining Crystal Shards reduced from 0.002 to 0.001

(Previous updates increased Crystal Shards Yield from minor insects by a considerable amount, and these two upgrades have become too overpowered since, so we are adjusting the numbers here)

Crosshair is now more visible
Bolded and highlighted auto-firing mode instruction (Press middle mouse button to toggle the auto-firing mode!)

Fixed a bug where the Arc Sphere would stop following the player upon returning to main menu and re-entering the game

Mecha Slayer

Attack relentlessly
High movement speed
Immune to collision damage
